descripcion: Root-free, Shizuku-free lightweight Android app manager (<1MB APK, <10MB storage). Boost laggy & legacy devices with app freezing, background restriction, AOT compilation, and sustained performance mode—slashing battery drain while locking in peak smoothness. Free, open source. 免 Root、免 Shizuku 的超轻量 Android 应用管理器（APK <1MB，总占用 <10MB），唤醒卡顿安卓机型的原生流畅度!
